name: @magpie-community/page-claude-zh
description: 在 Windows 上为 Claude Desktop 的第三方 Gateway 模式加载简体或繁体中文界面，不修改 Claude 安装文件。Simplified and Traditional Chinese for Claude Desktop's third-party Gateway mode on Windows, without modifying the Claude installation.
author: Ethan L (https://github.com/ethanweave)

summary.en: Simplified and Traditional Chinese for Claude Desktop in third-party Gateway mode on Windows. Loads MIT-licensed Chinese catalogs into the running frontend without modifying Claude's files, and supports current builds that ship ion-dist.asar. Requires Node.js 22+, does not bypass Claude sign-in, and may briefly show DevTools and native file dialogs while applying.
summary.zh: 在 Windows 上为 Claude Desktop 的第三方 Gateway 模式加载简体或繁体中文。把 MIT 许可的中文词典写入运行中的前端，不改 Claude 安装文件，并支持当前使用 ion-dist.asar 的版本。需要 Node.js 22+，不绕过 Claude 登录，应用时可能短暂出现调试窗口和文件选择框。
